en.headline: One own commit plus 14 automated commits
en.summary: On 2026-10-13, `sogeisetsu` recorded **1 own commit** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, alongside 14 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own commit was a fix in the daily pipeline so that blank days no longer swallow the discussion and other appended sections. No pull requests, reviews, issues, or releases were recorded that day. The user also started two new discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`, both in the Ideas category: `#4821` titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" and `#4823` titled "[Idea] Expose session context and usage stats to extensions via the SDK". Both discussions had 0 comments at the time of reporting. No replies, stars, or state changes were logged.

zh.headline: 1 次本人提交加 14 次自动提交；新开两个 openchamber 想法讨论
